podcasts.title: Kareem Amin - The Unusual Approach to Company Building - [Invest Like the Best, EP.478]
podcasts.description: My guest today is Kareem Amin, co-founder and CEO of Clay. Clay has become one of the fastest-growing software companies of the last few years, valued at over four billion dollars. It helps companies find their best customers and reach them at scale. But this conversation is about a lot more than Clay. Kareem is one of the most original thinkers I know.
